landing.heroTitleLine1: Your next hire, pre-screened by AI
landing.heroDescription: Recruito connects companies with pre-screened candidates through AI-powered matching and vetted recruiters.
landing.heroBullet2Desc: Transparent, tailored fees for each hire
landing.heroBullet3Desc: Handpicked candidates perfectly suited for your roles
landing.heroBullet4Desc: Ensure speed and efficiency with recruiter engagement
landing.heroBullet5Desc: Publish only on our platform for personalized service and special discounts
landing.step1Desc: The company posts a job listing with requirements and budget. Up to 5 recruiters can take the assignment.
landing.step2Desc: Approved recruiters present their best candidates from their networks. You choose the best ones.
landing.step3Desc: Pay from 12% of annual salary on a successful hire. Lower fees with more placements.

company.notificationsBody:
Recruiters will receive an email and an in-platform (Recruito) notification whenever a job is paused or made live, along with the reason.
Please be careful when changing the job status.
company.importantNote1: Once a job is published, the client cannot edit the job details. Please ensure all information is accurate before publishing.
company.importantNote2: Clients may add additional notes if something is missing after publication.
company.importantNote3: Alternatively, they can pause the job and publish a new one with updated details.
company.importantNote4: Once published, there is no option for the client to permanently delete the job.

legal.termsIntro: By using Recruito, you accept these terms. The service may only be used for lawful recruitment purposes.
legal.termsAccountSharing: Accounts may not be shared with unauthorized persons. The user is responsible for ensuring that information published on the platform is accurate and compliant with applicable law.
legal.responsibilityText: Recruito provides a platform for matching companies with recruiters. The parties are themselves responsible for agreements, selection decisions, and employment law obligations.
legal.contactText: Questions about terms should be sent to legal@recruito.se.
legal.privacyIntro: Recruito processes personal data to deliver the recruitment service to companies, recruiters, and candidates. We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Swedish legislation.
legal.privacyDataTypes: Personal data that may be processed includes contact details, CV information, communications on the platform, and history related to recruitment processes.
legal.purposeServiceDelivery: Delivery of the service and agreed functionality.
legal.purposeCommunication: Communication between parties in the recruitment process.
legal.purposeLegalObligations: Legal obligations, accounting, and security measures.
legal.storageText: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose or as required by law. Candidate data may be anonymized or deleted once the recruitment process has concluded and legal requirements have been met.
legal.yourRightsText: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, and to object to certain processing. For questions or requests, contact us at privacy@recruito.se.
legal.gdprIntro: Recruito normally acts as a data controller for account data and as a data processor in parts of the recruitment workflow, depending on the service used and which party determines the purpose.
legal.gdprSecurityMeasures: We apply technical and organizational security measures, including access control, logging, and the principle of least privilege.
legal.registerExtractText: Contact us at privacy@recruito.se if you wish to request a data extract or exercise other rights under the GDPR.
legal.supervisoryAuthorityText: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY) if you believe our processing violates the GDPR.
